# Introduction

The Linux command line is an essential tool for modern research computing, particularly in bioinformatics and genomics.

This note contains the Linux commands that I use frequently for navigating directories, managing files, inspecting data, and working with research datasets.

## 1. Navigating the File System

### `pwd`

Print the current working directory.
